guide.soulcatcherplus.name: Soul Catcher's Guide
guide.soulcatcherplus.landing: Mark an enemy, claim its soul and build your collection of spectral companions.$(br2)This guide covers equipment, orders, soul energy and the Forgotten Souls.
guide.soulcatcherplus.subtitle: Soul Catcher Plus
guide.soulcatcherplus.basics.name: Soul catching
guide.soulcatcherplus.equipment.name: Equipment & recipes
guide.soulcatcherplus.equipment.descript: Scythes, cages and this guide. All recipes are linked to their in-game definitions.
guide.soulcatcherplus.enchantments.name: Enchantments
guide.soulcatcherplus.enchantments.descr: Increase energy, cage capacity and companion slots.
guide.soulcatcherplus.forgotten.name: Forgotten Souls
guide.soulcatcherplus.forgotten.descript: Rare companions with their own roles.
guide.soulcatcherplus.basics.capture.pag: First craft a scythe and a soul cage. Carry the cage in your offhand or hotbar.$(br2)In Harvest mode, right-click an enemy with the scythe to mark it. The mark lasts three minutes.
Defeat the marked enemy before the mark expires. A soul remnant appears; right-click it with a scythe to add that form to your collection.
Only the marking player can collect it. The remnant lasts one minute.
Your own kills and kills credited to your souls award energy. A marked kill can also unlock a companion.
A known form does not award energy a second time when collected. Some entity types or native abilities may need an external compatibility addon.
guide.soulcatcherplus.basics.energy.name: Soul energy
guide.soulcatcherplus.basics.energy.page: Energy is stored in cage items, while your soul collection belongs to your character.
A kill yields half the enemy's maximum HP, rounded down, with a minimum of 1. Summoning costs twice its maximum HP, rounded up.
The offhand cage takes priority. Otherwise the leftmost hotbar cage is active.
Summoning spends energy from that cage only: several small cages cannot combine their balances to pay for an expensive soul.
Incoming energy fills the offhand cage first, then spills through the hotbar from left to right. Excess is lost if every available cage is full.
Recall refunds half the companion's current HP, rounded down.
Hold any scythe in either hand and press $(k:key.soulcatcherplus.collection) to open the collection. The default key is O.$(br2)Search by name, scroll the list and use the star to pin favorite creatures to the top.
Different captured appearances unlock separate forms. You may summon only one form of a creature type at a time.
Souls with at least 150 maximum HP are highlighted purple. Delete removes only the selected form and asks for confirmation.
Select a form and press Summon. You need an available slot and enough energy in the active cage.
The color-picker button adjusts your souls' tint and opacity (10–100%%) and can reset them. White tint keeps their original colors.
guide.soulcatcherplus.basics.orders.name: Orders
guide.soulcatcherplus.basics.orders.page: Hold a scythe and hold $(k:key.soulcatcherplus.command_wheel) (default R) to open the wheel.
Hover a soul, then an order; release the key to issue it. Returning the pointer to the center clears the focused soul. All creatures targets the whole group.
$(thing)Follow$(): accompany the owner and respond to combat.$(br2)$(thing)Aggressive$(): follow while actively seeking nearby hostile mobs.$(br2)$(thing)Wait$(): stay in place and stop fighting.
$(thing)Guard$(): defend the point where the order was issued.$(br2)$(thing)Teleport$(): try to move the selected soul or group to a safe place near you.
$(thing)Recall$(): dismiss and refund half of current HP as energy.

To attack one target, switch the scythe to Command mode in the collection, then right-click the enemy.$(br2)The collection also has order buttons and a group toggle. Change O and R in Minecraft's Controls settings.
guide.soulcatcherplus.basics.lifecycle.p: A summoned soul starts with full health and keeps supported native abilities. It has an owner-prefixed name for maps; overhead name labels are hidden.
Its bonded summons inherit ownership when the summoning relationship can be identified.
When a companion dies, its collection entry survives but needs one minute to recover. Recall is available before death.
Souls persist across a normal rejoin. Following souls return when too far away; Teleport lets you call them sooner.
Iron / diamond / netherite / supreme scythes provide 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 companion slots.
Taking a weaker scythe limits new summons; it does not dismiss existing ones. Scythes accept normal sword enchantments.
guide.soulcatcherplus.equipment.cages.pa: Base capacities: iron 150, diamond 400, netherite 1,000, supreme 2,000.$(br2)Keep a cage in your offhand or hotbar for collecting and summoning. Netherite equipment is upgraded at a smithing table.
guide.soulcatcherplus.equipment.guide.pa: With Patchouli installed, you receive this guide once on joining the world. Death and later logins do not grant extra copies.
Craft a replacement with a book and soul sand in any arrangement. Without Patchouli, the guide integration is inactive.
guide.soulcatcherplus.enchantments.harve: Soul Harvester has two levels. Each adds 50%% to energy from kills while an enchanted scythe is held.
Level I: ×1.5. Level II: ×2. Two scythes use the stronger level rather than stacking. The bonus affects energy, not unlocked forms.
guide.soulcatcherplus.enchantments.capac: Soul Capacity enchants cages and has three levels. Each adds one third of base capacity.
Level III doubles the original capacity. For example, a supreme cage increases from 2,000 to 4,000. Fractions are rounded down once.
guide.soulcatcherplus.enchantments.slots: Soul Slot is a rare, one-level armor enchantment. Each worn enchanted armor piece adds one companion slot, up to +4 for a full set.
With a supreme scythe, the maximum is eight slots. Our enchantments use normal enchanting/book pools, without an extra chest-book roll.
A scroll contains one soul form. Its tooltip identifies it. Right-click the scroll to add the form to your collection and consume the scroll.
Normal, boss and Forgotten Soul scrolls have different appearances. Forgotten companions are unlocked by scrolls, not scythe capture.
Eligible chest loot tables have a 2%% chance to add a Forgotten Soul scroll. Raven, Courier and Shaman are equally likely.
A scroll teaches the form; it does not summon for free. Normal energy costs and slot limits still apply.
guide.soulcatcherplus.forgotten.raven.pa: A passive 4-HP collector that rests on your shoulder. Within 20 blocks of you, it gathers accessible dropped items and your collectible soul remnants.
It carries up to eight stacks or remnants per trip and returns them to you.
A full inventory does not stop collection: overflow is left at your feet. Recall or death releases carried items at the raven's position.
Collecting remnants still requires a cage and room in the collection. The raven does not fight.
A passive 8-HP skeleton porter with an Ender Chest. Right-click the courier to open your own Ender Chest inventory.
Other players can use it too, but each sees their own inventory. The courier is an access point, not shared storage.
The courier supports normal companion orders and stays still while its chest is being used.
Closing, recalling or losing the courier does not delete the Ender Chest contents: they belong to the accessing player.
guide.soulcatcherplus.forgotten.shaman.p: A passive 8-HP support soul. Stay within six blocks of the shaman to receive its aura.
Every seven seconds it casts Strength I and Regeneration I for eight seconds on you and your active souls within six blocks of you.
The staff gesture and short sound mark the cast. Bonded minions can receive the aura too; other players and pets do not.
Vanilla immunities remain: undead do not gain regeneration. Leaving or recalling stops refreshes; existing buffs expire naturally.
